description: A Java class 'MidiPrinter' that provides static methods for formatting MIDI messages and device information for printing and debugging purposes.

classes.name: MidiPrinter
classes.description: Provides static methods for formatting MIDI messages and device info

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for a MIDI status byte

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Returns a string representing a sequence of bytes in hexadecimal

methods.name: formatMessage
methods.description: Formats a MIDI message byte array into a human-readable string

methods.name: formatDeviceInfo
methods.description: Returns a string describing a MIDI device's properties and ports
